products.name: Heavyweight Crewneck
products.oneLiner: Lush fleece with hypnotic electronic accents
products.supplierBrief: 12–14 oz fleece crewneck, embroidered chest mark, numbered neck label, limited run.

description.text: This thick, twelve-ounce fleece crewneck features a soft black base with a subtle silver herringbone texture. A small, abstract electronic waveform motif in baby blue and magenta is embroidered on the chest, creating a hypnotic focal point. The oversized fit and premium feel evoke high-end streetwear, while the muted palette ensures timeless versatility for seasonal layering.

products.name: Embroidered Patch Set
products.oneLiner: Punk-inspired hip-hop textures on iron-on patches
products.supplierBrief: Set of 2 iron-on embroidered patches, 3 in, merrowed border, digitizing fee applies.

description.text: Two square patches display rugged, high-density embroidery on a black canvas base. One features a jagged silver soundwave, while the other shows a magenta and baby blue geometric hiphop symbol. The merrowed edges provide a durable, workwear aesthetic, and the tactile thread creates a distinct, punk-inspired texture that complements jackets and denim with industrial grit.

products.name: Printed Bandana
products.oneLiner: Hypnotic electronic patterns in vibrant festival colors
products.supplierBrief: 22 in square cotton bandana, 1–2 colour all-over print.

description.text: A square cotton bandana displays a seamless, all-over print of concentric silver and baby blue circles. Interspersed with sharp magenta lines, the design mimics a hypnotic electronic rhythm. The black background grounds the vibrant palette, creating a striking visual impact suitable for festival wear or street style, blending vintage folk shapes with modern digital energy.

products.name: Cassette-Style USB
products.oneLiner: Retro cassette drive with neon electronic motifs
products.supplierBrief: Cassette-style 8 GB USB pre-loaded with the artist's own tracks, printed J-card insert.

description.text: This USB drive mimics a vintage cassette shape with a matte black plastic shell. The front label features a glowing silver and baby blue frequency wave, accented by a single magenta dot. The design evokes a hypnotic, analog-digital fusion, offering a nostalgic collectible that bridges classic hiphop media with modern electronic music storage in a sleek, tactile form.

products.name: Heavyweight Tee
products.oneLiner: Streetwear staple with hypnotic screen-printed waves
products.supplierBrief: 6.5 oz cotton tee, 1–2 colour screen print front, small back print, sizes S–XXL.

description.text: A sturdy, mid-weight cotton tee in deep black features a bold, two-color screen print on the chest. The design consists of overlapping silver and magenta soundwaves, creating a hypnotic, electronic visual effect. A small baby blue geometric detail appears on the back collar, adding subtle hiphop-inspired styling to the minimalist streetwear silhouette for everyday durability.

products.name: Playing Card Deck
products.oneLiner: Hypnotic card art with neon electronic themes
products.supplierBrief: 54-card poker-size deck with custom back and 4 custom face cards, tuck box.

description.text: This poker-sized deck features a custom back design of swirling silver and baby blue lines on a black background, evoking hypnotic electronic frequencies. The four face cards replace traditional figures with abstract magenta and silver hiphop-inspired geometric shapes. The tuck box matches the deck’s vibrant, futuristic aesthetic, making it a collectible art piece for card enthusiasts and music fans.

products.name: Art Print Poster
products.oneLiner: Hypnotic electronic art on matte paper
products.supplierBrief: 18×24 in matte poster on 100 lb stock, single design, shipped in tubes.

description.text: This large-format poster displays a monochromatic black background with a central, hypnotic burst of silver and baby blue light rays. A single magenta accent line cuts through the composition, adding dynamic tension. The matte finish enhances the depth of the colors, creating a cinematic, vintage-inspired visual that captures the essence of electronic music in a minimalist, gallery-ready format.

steps.note: Launch the reliable sellers first — smallest cash at risk.
Take pre-orders for the statement piece — gauge demand before the print run.
Numbered edition. Scarce by design — one run, then gone.

dropPlan.firstRunTip: Order less than you think you'll sell — a sell-out creates demand.
